title: Join a session: opt-in search, address and code, clear refusals
covers: Join a session: find servers, probe, listed-only note, wrong code, mismatch
context: Join a session joins a host as a player. Looking for servers on the network is opt-in and stops when you stop looking. An address and a code show the session first. Problems read as plain sentences. The page opens from the button Join a session on Sessions, and from the idle main window. The host side is the tab of a session.
changed: views/JoinSession: discovery only while looking, the probe line, mismatch and listed-only sentences

setup.label: launch
setup.text: The bundle-4 launch above. If the welcome tour opens by itself, press Skip.

setup.label: engine
setup.text: Ready (the Engine page under App shows Ready).

setup.label: game
setup.text: A Link to the Past installed: Library, Games, tab Built-in, press Add on its card.

setup.label: engines
setup.text: For step 7 two engines are installed (Engine under App, Installed engines). Skip step 7 with one engine.

setup.label: other server
setup.text: Optional: a second Archipelia on this network in LAN mode, or the headless server with ARCHIPELIA_NETWORK=lan.

steps: Make a session Join check: Allow direct connections on, Allow unlisted clients off, one player Host1 with A Link to the Past. Press Save and run. In the tab copy the session code and, in the Network widget, the Lobby address.
Open Sessions, press Join a session. The page says Archipelia listens on your network only while you look for servers.

Press Find servers on my network. The button becomes Stop looking, and servers list with name, address, Archipelago version and Open sessions or No open session. With none, a sentence says no other server was found. Press Stop looking.

Paste the address and the code and press Look at the session. A line shows the name, the version and Open for players, and a note says the session takes listed clients only, so ask the host to turn on Allow unlisted clients.
Close the tab. In Sessions turn Allow unlisted clients on for Join check and press Run. Copy the new session code. In Join a session look at the session again: the note is gone.
Change one character of the code and press Look at the session. A red line gives a plain sentence and nothing crashes. Put the code back.

Open Engine (App) and Switch to an installed engine with another Archipelago vers In Join a session press Look at the sess A sentence names the Archipelago version of the session and of this computer, and says to ins Switch the engine back.
pass: Nothing listens for servers until you press Find servers on my network, and Stop looking stops it.
Address and code show the session. A listed clients only session and a mismatched version each give a clear sentence.
A wrong code gives a plain sentence and the page stays usable.
fail: The page searches the network on its own, or Stop looking does not stop it.
A refusal shows a code, a stack or a blank line instead of a sentence.
notes: In step 7 the session may follow the engine in use, so both sides always agree. If no mismatch can be made on one computer, use a second PC with another engine.
Found servers need another Archipelia or the headless server on the network. With none, the empty sentence is the pass for step 3.
The states Waiting for the host, Refused, Approved, Room open and the reconnect are in the next test.
